title: Boss: release and run
summary: Gate a release, check every environment's configuration, and alert on what matters.

steps.title: The brief
body: Acme is promoting `catalogue-integration` from test to production. You build the checks the pipeline runs
before production, and the alert rules on-call will live with.

steps.title: Same artifact, different parameters
prompt: The tests declare `record Release(string Env, string ImageDigest, Dictionary<string, string> Params);`.
Write `List<string> PromotionProblems(List<Release> releases, string[] requiredParams)`, in this order:
- if the releases don't all use the **same** `ImageDigest`: `"image differs: {env}"` for each environment whose digest differs from the **first** release's;
- for each release (in order) and each required parameter (in order) that is missing or empty: `"{env}: missing {param}"`;
- for each parameter whose value contains `"localhost"` or `"127.0.0.1"` in any release other than one named `dev`: `"{env}: {param} points at the local machine"`;
- for each release, any parameter whose name ends with `.password`, `.secret` or `.api-key` and whose value does **not** start with `{{env:` or `vault:`: `"{env}: {param} is a literal secret"`.
solution: if (!r.Params.TryGetValue(p, out var v) || string.IsNullOrEmpty(v)) problems.Add($"{r.Env}: missing {p}");
if (v.Contains("localhost") || v.Contains("127.0.0.1")) problems.Add($"{r.Env}: {k} points at the local machine");
hints: Four separate loops, one per kind of problem, keep the required order easy.
template: {{CODE}}
var dojoReq = new[] { "catalogue.url", "catalogue.api-key" };
var dojoGood = new List<Release>
new("test", "sha256:aa", new() { ["catalogue.url"] = "http://catalogue.test:8080", ["catalogue.api-key"] = "{{env:CATALOGUE_API_KEY}}" }),
new("prod", "sha256:aa", new() { ["catalogue.url"] = "http://catalogue.prod:8080", ["catalogue.api-key"] = "vault:kv/catalogue#key" }),
Dojo.Eq("a clean promotion", new List<string>(), PromotionProblems(dojoGood, dojoReq));
var dojoBad = new List<Release>
new("dev", "sha256:aa", new() { ["catalogue.url"] = "http://localhost:8089", ["catalogue.api-key"] = "{{env:K}}" }),
new("test", "sha256:bb", new() { ["catalogue.url"] = "http://127.0.0.1:8089", ["catalogue.api-key"] = "{{env:K}}" }),
new("prod", "sha256:aa", new() { ["catalogue.url"] = "", ["catalogue.api-key"] = "hunter2" }),
Dojo.Eq("every problem, in order", new List<string>
"image differs: test",
"prod: missing catalogue.url",
"test: catalogue.url points at the local machine",
"prod: catalogue.api-key is a literal secret",
}, PromotionProblems(dojoBad, dojoReq));
record Release(string Env, string ImageDigest, Dictionary<string, string> Params);

steps.title: Alert rules
prompt: Per minute, the platform collects `record Minute(int Total, int ServerErrors, int Auth4xx, int TooMany, int P95Ms, bool HealthUp);`.
Write `List<string> Alerts(List<Minute> minutes)` evaluating the **last 5 minutes** (or all, if fewer):
- `"health down"` if the **latest** minute has `HealthUp == false`;
- `"error rate {r}%"` if the server errors over the window ÷ total over the window is **at least 5%** (`r` rounded down to a whole number; skip when the total is 0);
- `"latency p95 {ms} ms"` if the p95 was above `1000` in **every** minute of the window (one slow minute is noise), using the latest minute's value;
- `"auth spike"` if the latest minute's `Auth4xx` is more than **3 times** the average of the earlier minutes in the window and at least `20`;
- `"throttling"` if `TooMany` summed over the window is more than 10% of the total.
In that order.
solution: if (total > 0 && w.Sum(m => m.ServerErrors) * 100 / total >= 5) alerts.Add($"error rate {w.Sum(m => m.ServerErrors) * 100 / total}%");
hints: Take the window with `Skip(Math.Max(0, count - 5))`; `w[^1]` is the latest minute.
Integer arithmetic `errors * 100 / total` rounds down for you.
template: {{CODE}}
Minute Ok(int p95 = 80, int auth = 2) => new(1000, 3, auth, 5, p95, true);
Dojo.Eq("a quiet hour", new List<string>(), Alerts(new() { Ok(), Ok(), Ok(), Ok(), Ok(), Ok() }));
Dojo.Eq("error rate over the window", new List<string> { "error rate 6%" },
Dojo.Eq("one slow minute is noise", new List<string>(), Alerts(new() { Ok(), Ok(), Ok(2000), Ok(), Ok() }));
Dojo.Eq("slow for the whole window", new List<string> { "latency p95 1800 ms" }, Alerts(new() { Ok(80), Ok(1500), Ok(1200), Ok(1100), Ok(1300), Ok(1800) }));
Dojo.Eq("auth spike and health", new List<string> { "health down", "auth spike" },
Alerts(new() { Ok(auth: 4), Ok(auth: 6), Ok(auth: 5), new(1000, 3, 90, 5, 80, false) }));
Dojo.Eq("throttling", new List<string> { "throttling" }, Alerts(new() { new(100, 0, 0, 30, 50, true) }));
Dojo.Eq("no data", new List<string>(), Alerts(new()));
record Minute(int Total, int ServerErrors, int Auth4xx, int TooMany, int P95Ms, bool HealthUp);

steps.title: The onboarding gate
prompt: Before an API goes live, the pipeline checks its onboarding record. The tests declare:
```csharp
record Onboarding(string Name, bool HasContract, string Shape, bool HasProjectFolder, bool UsesSharedErrorHandler,
bool SecretsInConfig, bool PublishedOnGateway, bool MockModeOff, bool OldEndpointRetired);
`Shape` is `"pass-through"` or `"integration"`. Write `List<string> Gate(Onboarding o)` returning, in this order:
- `"{name}: no contract"` if there is no contract;
- for a pass-through: `"{name}: a pass-through needs no project folder"` if it has one;

- for an integration: `"{name}: missing project folder"`, `"{name}: use the shared error handler"`, `"{name}: secrets must come from configuration"`, `"{name}: turn mock mode off"` for each missing item;
- `"{name}: not published on the gateway"` if it is not published yet;
- `"{name}: retire the old endpoint"` if the old one still runs.
solution: if (o.HasProjectFolder) p.Add($"{o.Name}: a pass-through needs no project folder");
if (!o.UsesSharedErrorHandler) p.Add($"{o.Name}: use the shared error handler");
if (!o.SecretsInConfig) p.Add($"{o.Name}: secrets must come from configuration");
if (!o.MockModeOff) p.Add($"{o.Name}: turn mock mode off");
if (!o.PublishedOnGateway) p.Add($"{o.Name}: not published on the gateway");
if (!o.OldEndpointRetired) p.Add($"{o.Name}: retire the old endpoint");
hints: Follow the list top to bottom; the shape decides which middle block applies.
template: {{CODE}}
Dojo.Eq("a finished integration", new List<string>(), Gate(new("catalogue", true, "integration", true, true, true, true, true, true)));
Dojo.Eq("a finished pass-through (mock and handler don't apply)", new List<string>(), Gate(new("shipping-rates", true, "pass-through", false, false, false, true, false, true)));
Dojo.Eq("a pass-through with a needless project", new List<string> { "shipping-rates: a pass-through needs no project folder", "shipping-rates: retire the old endpoint" },
Gate(new("shipping-rates", true, "pass-through", true, false, false, true, false, false)));
Dojo.Eq("an unfinished integration", new List<string>
"orders: no contract", "orders: use the shared error handler", "orders: secrets must come from configuration",
"orders: turn mock mode off", "orders: not published on the gateway",
}, Gate(new("orders", false, "integration", true, false, false, false, false, true)));

record Onboarding(string Name, bool HasContract, string Shape, bool HasProjectFolder, bool UsesSharedErrorHandler, bool SecretsInConfig, bool PublishedOnGateway, bool MockModeOff, bool OldEndpointRetired);
